Scope: this workbook covers D11-D29 from the companion 'Deliverables Structure — Full Specs' PDD, EXCLUDING D15 (AI Use Cases) and D26 (Modules and Tiers), which live in the separate D01-D10/D15/D26 workbook (the 'PDD' document) to keep each source PDD's scope in its own file. Every cross-reference to D01, D02, D03, D04, D05, D06, D08, D09, D15 or D26 in this workbook (e.g., Linked_Macro_ID, Linked_Task_ID, AI_Use_Case_ID) is an ID that resolves in the companion D01-D10/D15/D26 file — the two workbooks are designed to be used side by side.
Numbering note — D30 and Change Management Charters

D30 is officially reserved for the 'Licensing Implementation Schema' — a separate, detailed technical source document (LicenceProvider abstraction, SaaS vs. OnPrem implementation, Ed25519 signing, hardware binding, per-platform license-file handling) that is NOT built into this workbook. The Change Management Charters deliverable (Sponsorship, Participative Management, Communication, Organizational Impact, Team/One-to-One Coaching, Mentoring, Pulse/Interview) was previously drafted under a placeholder 'D27' before the official numbering was known, then moved to 'D30' when D27 turned out to be reserved for Stakeholder Journeys. Now that D30 is confirmed as Licensing, Charters has been renumbered a second time to D31/D31a/D31b/D31c. No charter content changed across either rename — only the deliverable prefix.
Revision note — journi Functional Specification v1.3 gap analysis

D32 through D32k (12 sheets) are NEW in this revision, added to close gaps identified between this workbook and journi Functional Specification v1.3 — principally Module 18 (Work Breakdown Structure & Gantt, entirely new: D32a-f), Module 19's End-to-End Process Registry and Cross-Type Comparison Matrix (D32h, D32i), Module 17's underlying NLP/coding engines (D32j, D32k), and Section 2.4's server-side persistence requirement (D32). D09/D10 (companion workbook), D11, D13, D18, and D21 in this workbook also gained fields/rows in the same revision — see each sheet's own footnote for what changed. Two items the gap analysis flagged as CRITICAL GAP — macro-level SIPOC and 5-column macro-level RACSI — were found to already be fully covered by D01's existing field structure; see D01's footnote in the companion workbook for confirmation rather than a schema change.
